title: Resolution data for the coefficient sequence projection
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $W$, and the completed ring $A$ and quotient sequence ring $B$ on the ringed sequence site of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Fix a supplied calculus $S$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define resolution data to consist of the constant-system ringed projection in the independent-universe interface of [def-pur-ringed-topos-morphism-of-universes], its quotient structural map, its ordinary tensor/limit module adjunction with tensor-quotient transitions and the actual scalar-extension Hom transposes, and its factorization through the constant ring $A$. The ring-change module functor is exact, and the constant-ring modules are identified with towers, on unchanged sections and transitions. On the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], include universal derived functors $L,R$ with their comparison transformations, a normalized derived adjunction, and natural isomorphisms $L\cong S.\mathcal R$, $R\cong\mathcal L$ identifying units and counits. The left comparison computes on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and agrees with the supplied strict finite scalar-extension model including quotient transitions. For every K-injective system complex $I$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and every K-injective replacement $j:UI\to J$, include the equation identifying the right comparison with $\lim j$, which is a quasi-isomorphism. For arbitrary $N$ and any simultaneous replacement $j:UN\to J$, its comparison $\mathcal L(QN)\cong Q(\lim J)$ is exactly the localization comparison followed by $R\lim(Qj)$ and the canonical K-injective model isomorphism. This record specifies data and equations; its definition asserts no existence.
